questions.q: Which tag gives the largest heading on a web page?
questions.qAf: Watter etiket gee die grootste opskrif op 'n webblad?
questions.explain: <h1> is the largest heading (the main title) and <h6> is the smallest. <head> holds metadata, and <title> shows in the browser tab.
questions.explainAf: <h1> is die grootste opskrif (die hooftitel) en <h6> die kleinste. <head> bevat metadata, en <title> wys in die blaaieroortjie.

questions.q: A learner wants a bulleted list with square bullets. Which opening tag must they use?
questions.qAf: 'n Leerder wil 'n kolpuntlys met vierkantige kolpunte hê. Watter openingsetiket moet die leerder gebruik?
questions.explain: A bulleted list is an unordered list, <ul>. Its type can be square, circle or disc. <ol> is a numbered (ordered) list, and <li> is one list item.
questions.explainAf: 'n Kolpuntlys is 'n ongeordende lys, <ul>. Sy type-attribuut kan square, circle of disc wees. <ol> is 'n genommerde (geordende) lys, en <li> is een lysitem.

questions.q: In the CSS rule h1 { color: blue; }, what is h1?
questions.qAf: Wat is h1 in die CSS-reël h1 { color: blue; }?
questions.explain: A rule set is a selector plus a declaration. h1 is the selector; color: blue; is the declaration, where color is the property and blue is the value.
questions.explainAf: 'n Reëlstel is 'n selektor plus 'n deklarasie. h1 is die selektor; color: blue; is die deklarasie, waarin color die eienskap en blue die waarde is.

questions.q: What colour is the hexadecimal colour #00FF00?
questions.qAf: Watter kleur is die heksadesimale kleur #00FF00?
questions.explain: Hexadecimal colours are #RRGGBB, with FF = 255 and 00 = 0. #00FF00 is no red, full green and no blue, the same as rgb(0, 255, 0).
questions.explainAf: Heksadesimale kleure is #RRGGBB, met FF = 255 en 00 = 0. #00FF00 beteken geen rooi, volle groen en geen blou nie, dieselfde as rgb(0, 255, 0).

questions.q: Cells A1 to A5 hold: Apple, 10, 20, (empty), 30. What does =AVERAGE(A1:A5) give?
questions.qAf: Selle A1 tot A5 bevat: Appel, 10, 20, (leeg), 30. Wat gee =AVERAGE(A1:A5)?
questions.explain: AVERAGE ignores text and blanks, so it works with 10, 20 and 30 only: (10 + 20 + 30) ÷ 3 = 60 ÷ 3 = 20.
questions.explainAf: AVERAGE ignoreer teks en leë selle, dus werk dit net met 10, 20 en 30: (10 + 20 + 30) ÷ 3 = 60 ÷ 3 = 20.

questions.q: What is the next number in the pattern 1, 2, 4, 7, 11, …?
questions.qAf: Wat is die volgende getal in die patroon 1, 2, 4, 7, 11, …?
questions.explain: The differences are +1, +2, +3, +4, so they grow by 1 each time. The next difference is +5, and 11 + 5 = 16.
questions.explainAf: Die verskille is +1, +2, +3, +4, dus word hulle elke keer 1 groter. Die volgende verskil is +5, en 11 + 5 = 16.

questions.q: Which line correctly stores a learner's height of 1.65 m in Java?
questions.qAf: Watter reël stoor 'n leerder se lengte van 1,65 m korrek in Java?
questions.explain: 1.65 is a decimal, so it needs a double. An int stores whole numbers only, a boolean stores only true or false, and a String needs text in double quotes.
questions.explainAf: 1,65 is 'n desimale getal (in Java geskryf as 1.65), dus het dit 'n double nodig. 'n int stoor net heelgetalle, 'n boolean net true of false, en 'n String het teks tussen dubbele aanhalingstekens nodig.

questions.q: Which of these is a valid Java variable name?
questions.qAf: Watter van hierdie is 'n geldige Java-veranderlikenaam?
questions.explain: A name may not start with a number (1stPlayer), may not contain spaces (player score) and may not be a reserved word (public). The underscore is the only special character allowed, so player_1 is valid.
questions.explainAf: 'n Naam mag nie met 'n getal begin nie (1stPlayer), mag nie spasies bevat nie (player score) en mag nie 'n gereserveerde woord wees nie (public). Die onderstreepteken is die enigste spesiale karakter wat toegelaat word, dus is player_1 geldig.

questions.q: What is an embedded system?
questions.qAf: Wat is 'n ingebedde stelsel?
options: A computer that can run almost any software
A specialised computer built for one specific, dedicated job
The brain of a general-purpose computer
A program that runs inside a web page
optionsAf: 'n Rekenaar wat byna enige sagteware kan laat loop
'n Gespesialiseerde rekenaar wat vir een spesifieke, toegewyde taak gebou is
Die brein van 'n rekenaar vir algemene gebruik
questions.explain: An embedded system does one dedicated job, like a router, a microwave controller or a car engine controller. A general-purpose computer can run almost any software.
questions.explainAf: 'n Ingebedde stelsel doen een toegewyde taak, soos 'n roeteerder, 'n mikrogolfbeheerder of 'n motorenjinbeheerder. 'n Rekenaar vir algemene gebruik kan byna enige sagteware laat loop.

sections.title: True or false
sections.intro: Decide whether each statement is true or false.
sections.introAf: Besluit of elke stelling waar of onwaar is.

questions.q: HTML is a programming language.
questions.qAf: HTML is 'n programmeertaal.
questions.explain: HTML is a markup language that tells a browser how to display content. It is not a programming language.
questions.explainAf: HTML is 'n opmaaktaal wat vir 'n blaaier sê hoe om inhoud te vertoon. Dit is nie 'n programmeertaal nie.

questions.q: The alt text of an image is shown if the image fails to load.
questions.qAf: Die alt-teks van 'n prent word vertoon as die prent nie laai nie.
questions.explain: alt is the alternative text for blind users, and it shows when the image cannot load, for example when the picture is not in the same folder as the HTML file.
questions.explainAf: alt is die alternatiewe teks vir blinde gebruikers, en dit wys wanneer die prent nie kan laai nie, byvoorbeeld wanneer die prent nie in dieselfde vouer as die HTML-lêer is nie.

questions.q: Inline CSS is the preferred way to style a website.
questions.qAf: Inlyn-CSS is die voorkeurmanier om 'n webwerf te stileer.
questions.explain: Inline CSS is the worst way: you have to style each line separately. External CSS (a separate .css file) is preferred, because one file can style 50+ pages.
questions.explainAf: Inlyn-CSS is die swakste manier: jy moet die styl by elke etiket afsonderlik byvoeg. Eksterne CSS ('n aparte .css-lêer) word verkies, want een lêer kan 50+ bladsye stileer.

questions.q: If you delete a worksheet by mistake, you can undo it.
questions.qAf: As jy per ongeluk 'n werkblad skrap, kan jy dit ongedaan maak.
questions.explain: Deleting a sheet cannot be undone, so check before you delete.
questions.explainAf: 'n Werkblad wat geskrap is, kan nie herstel word nie (Undo werk nie), dus maak seker voordat jy skrap.

questions.q: In jGRASP, a syntax error stops the compiler, so no .class file is created.
questions.qAf: In jGRASP stop 'n sintaksfout die samesteller, dus word geen .class-lêer geskep nie.
questions.explain: The compiler only saves the bytecode as a .class file once the code has no syntax errors. Fix the error first, then compile again.
questions.explainAf: Die samesteller stoor die greepkode eers as 'n .class-lêer wanneer die kode geen sintaksfoute het nie. Maak eers die fout reg en klik dan weer Compile.

questions.q: Construction lines in FreeCAD become part of the final 3D model.
questions.qAf: Konstruksielyne in FreeCAD word deel van die finale 3D-model.
questions.explain: Construction lines are blue guide lines used to plan and measure. They are never part of the final 3D model.
questions.explainAf: Konstruksielyne is blou hulplyne wat gebruik word om te beplan en te meet. Hulle is nooit deel van die finale 3D-model nie.

questions.q: A voltmeter is connected in parallel and an ammeter in series.
questions.qAf: 'n Voltmeter word in parallel gekoppel en 'n ammeter in serie.
questions.explain: A voltmeter measures voltage across a component, so it goes in parallel. An ammeter measures the current flowing through, so it goes in series.
questions.explainAf: 'n Voltmeter meet die spanning oor 'n komponent, dus gaan dit in parallel. 'n Ammeter meet die stroom wat deurvloei, dus gaan dit in serie.

sections.title: Matching
sections.intro: Match column A to column B, and find the matching pairs.
sections.introAf: Pas kolom A by kolom B, en vind die pare wat bymekaar pas.

questions.q: Match each feature of the Arduino Uno in column A with its specification in column B.
questions.qAf: Pas elke kenmerk van die Arduino Uno in kolom A by sy spesifikasie in kolom B.
questions.explain: 7 to 12 V is the recommended input voltage through the barrel jack, not the operating voltage. Flash memory is non-volatile, so the program stays when the power is off; the 2 KB of SRAM holds variables only while the program runs.
questions.explainAf: 7 tot 12 V is die aanbevole insetspanning deur die kragaansluiting (barrel jack), nie die werkspanning nie. Flitsgeheue is nie-vlugtig, dus bly die program wanneer die krag af is; die 2 KB SRAM hou veranderlikes net terwyl die program loop.

questions.q: Find the matching pairs: link each pillar of computational thinking to an example of it.
questions.qAf: Vind die pare wat bymekaar pas: koppel elke pilaar van berekeningsdenke aan 'n voorbeeld daarvan.
pairs: Splitting the job of building a robot into parts, bolts and steps
Netflix suggesting shows like the ones you watched
A map that shows only roads and landmarks
Precise step-by-step instructions for a robot to make a sandwich
pairsAf: Om die bou van 'n robot in onderdele, boute en stappe op te deel
Netflix wat programme voorstel soos dié waarna jy gekyk het
'n Kaart wat net paaie en landmerke wys
Presiese stap-vir-stap-instruksies vir 'n robot om 'n toebroodjie te maak
questions.explain: Decomposition breaks a big problem into smaller parts. Pattern recognition spots repeats and trends to predict. Abstraction leaves out unnecessary detail. An algorithm is a clear, precise set of steps, because a robot has no intuition.
questions.explainAf: Ontbinding breek 'n groot probleem in kleiner dele op. Patroonherkenning sien herhalings en neigings raak sodat jy kan voorspel. Abstraksie laat onnodige besonderhede uit. 'n Algoritme is 'n duidelike, presiese stel stappe, want 'n robot het geen intuïsie nie.

questions.q: Match each FreeCAD term in column A with its meaning in column B.
questions.qAf: Pas elke FreeCAD-term in kolom A by sy betekenis in kolom B.
pairs: The main container that holds all the 3D features of one part
A flat 2D drawing on a chosen plane
A rounded edge added to a sharp corner
A reference surface you create to sketch from a new angle or position
pairsAf: Die hoofhouer wat al die 3D-kenmerke van een onderdeel bevat
'n Verwysingsoppervlak wat jy skep om uit 'n nuwe hoek of posisie te skets
extra: The point where the X, Y and Z axes meet
extraAf: Die punt waar die X-, Y- en Z-asse ontmoet
questions.explain: The extra description in column B is the Origin. A sketch is the starting point for a 3D shape, and a fillet makes a model smoother, safer and stronger.
questions.explainAf: Die ekstra beskrywing in kolom B is die Origin (oorsprong). 'n Skets is die beginpunt vir 'n 3D-vorm, en 'n afronding (fillet) maak 'n model gladder, veiliger en sterker.

sections.title: Steps in order
sections.intro: Put the steps in the correct order.
sections.introAf: Plaas die stappe in die korrekte volgorde.

questions.q: Put the steps for inserting a chart in Excel in the correct order.
questions.qAf: Plaas die stappe om 'n grafiek in Excel in te voeg, in die korrekte volgorde.
steps: Highlight them (hold Ctrl for columns that are not next to each other)
Select the chart type, e.g. 2D column or pie
stepsAf: Merk (highlight) hulle; hou Ctrl in vir kolomme wat nie langs mekaar is nie
Kies die grafiektipe, bv. 2D-kolomgrafiek of sirkelgrafiek
questions.explain: Decide, highlight, Insert tab, chart type. Afterwards the Chart Design tab changes the colours, style, layout or chart type.
questions.explainAf: Besluit, merk, Insert-oortjie, grafiektipe. Daarna verander die Chart Design-oortjie die kleure, styl, uitleg of grafiektipe.

questions.q: Put the steps for making a 3D part in FreeCAD in the correct order.
questions.qAf: Plaas die stappe om 'n 3D-onderdeel in FreeCAD te maak, in die korrekte volgorde.
steps: Create a sketch on the XY plane
Draw the outline and add constraints until the sketch turns green
Pad the sketch into a 3D part
stepsAf: Teken die buitelyn en voeg beperkings by totdat die skets groen word
Gebruik Pad om van die skets 'n 3D-onderdeel te maak
questions.explain: Every part starts with Create Body → Create Sketch → choose a plane. Fully constrain the sketch (green, zero DOF) before you Pad it, then save. The first save is Save As.
questions.explainAf: Elke onderdeel begin met Create Body → Create Sketch → kies 'n vlak. Beperk die skets volledig (groen, nul DOF) voordat jy Pad gebruik, en stoor dan. Die eerste keer stoor jy met Save As.

sections.title: Scenarios
sections.intro: Read each scenario, then answer the questions about it.
sections.introAf: Lees elke scenario en beantwoord dan die vrae daaroor.

questions.scenario: Sipho makes a page for the school's robotics club. This is his code:
questions.scenarioAf: Sipho maak 'n bladsy vir die skool se robotikaklub. Dit is sy kode:
questions.code:
Robotics Club

Meetings on Fridays

questions.q: Where will the words Robotics Club from the <title> tag appear?
questions.qAf: Waar sal die woorde Robotics Club uit die <title>-etiket verskyn?
options: As the biggest heading on the page
In the title bar or browser tab
Nowhere, because it is a comment
optionsAf: As die grootste opskrif op die bladsy
Nêrens nie, want dit is 'n kommentaar
questions.explain: The <title> sits in the <head>, which is not displayed on the page. The title shows in the title bar or browser tab. The big heading on the page comes from <h1>.
questions.explainAf: Die <title> sit in die <head>, wat nie op die bladsy vertoon word nie. Die titel wys in die titelbalk of blaaieroortjie. Die groot opskrif op die bladsy kom van <h1>.

questions.q: The page shows the words Our robot instead of the picture. What is the most likely reason?
questions.qAf: Die bladsy wys die woorde Our robot in plaas van die prent. Wat is die waarskynlikste rede?
options: The width and height are too big
robot.png is not in the same folder as the HTML file
The <a> tag is missing a closing tag
optionsAf: Die width en height is te groot
robot.png is nie in dieselfde vouer as die HTML-lêer nie
questions.explain: Keep pictures in the same folder as the HTML file, otherwise the image will not show and the alt text appears instead.
questions.explainAf: Hou prente in dieselfde vouer as die HTML-lêer, anders word die prent nie vertoon nie en verskyn die alt-teks in die plek daarvan.

questions.q: What happens when a visitor clicks the picture?
questions.qAf: Wat gebeur wanneer 'n besoeker op die prent klik?
options: Nothing, because pictures cannot be links
Wikipedia opens in a new tab
optionsAf: Niks nie, want prente kan nie skakels wees nie
Wikipedia maak in 'n nuwe oortjie oop
questions.explain: The is wrapped inside an tag, so the picture is a link. target="_blank" opens it in a new tab, which keeps visitors on Sipho's site.
questions.explainAf: Die is binne 'n -etiket toegedraai, dus is die prent 'n skakel. target="_blank" maak dit in 'n nuwe oortjie oop, wat besoekers op Sipho se webwerf hou.

questions.q: Sipho may use class="red-text" on several other paragraphs on the same page.
questions.qAf: Sipho mag class="red-text" op verskeie ander paragrawe op dieselfde bladsy gebruik.
questions.explain: A class is reusable and can be used many times. An id is the one that must be unique, used once per page.
questions.explainAf: 'n Klas is herbruikbaar en kan baie keer gebruik word. 'n id is die een wat uniek moet wees: een keer per bladsy.

questions.scenario: Zanele writes this code for her Gogga, ziggy.
questions.scenarioAf: Zanele skryf hierdie kode vir haar Gogga, ziggy.

questions.q: How many times does ziggy.move() run?
questions.qAf: Hoeveel keer word ziggy.move() uitgevoer?
questions.explain: counter starts at 0 and the loop runs while counter < 6, so it runs for 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5: 6 times.
questions.explainAf: counter begin by 0 en die lus loop solank counter < 6, dus word dit uitgevoer vir counter = 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 en 5: 6 keer.

questions.q: In the for loop, which part is counter++?
questions.qAf: Watter deel van die for-lus is counter++?
questions.explain: A for loop has three parts: initialisation (int counter = 0), condition (counter < 6) and increment (counter++, short for counter = counter + 1).
questions.explainAf: 'n for-lus het drie dele: inisialisering (int counter = 0), voorwaarde (counter < 6) en inkrement (counter++, die kort vorm van counter = counter + 1).

questions.q: Why is counter declared as an int?
questions.qAf: Hoekom word counter as 'n int gedeklareer?
questions.explain: counter counts 0, 1, 2, …, which are whole numbers, so int is the right data type.
questions.explainAf: counter tel 0, 1, 2, …, wat heelgetalle is, dus is int die regte datatipe.

questions.q: ziggy.turnRight() runs 6 times, once after every move.
questions.qAf: ziggy.turnRight() word 6 keer uitgevoer, een keer ná elke beweging.
questions.explain: ziggy.turnRight() comes after the closing } of the loop, so it is not repeated: it runs once, after all 6 moves.
questions.explainAf: ziggy.turnRight() kom ná die sluitende } van die lus, dus word dit nie herhaal nie: dit word net een keer uitgevoer, ná al 6 bewegings.

questions.scenario: Ayanda builds the Blinky LED circuit in TinkerCAD, but she powers it from a 9 V battery instead of an Arduino pin. The LED drops about 2 V, and she wants a current of 10 mA (0.01 A).
questions.scenarioAf: Ayanda bou die Blinky-LED-stroombaan in TinkerCAD, maar sy gebruik 'n 9 V-battery in plaas van 'n Arduino-pen. Die LED se spanningsval is ongeveer 2 V, en sy wil 'n stroom van 10 mA (0,01 A) hê.

questions.q: What voltage must the resistor take?
questions.qAf: Hoeveel spanning moet oor die resistor val?
questions.explain: The battery gives 9 V and the LED drops 2 V, so the resistor takes 9 − 2 = 7 V.
questions.explainAf: Die battery gee 9 V en die LED se spanningsval is 2 V, dus val 9 − 2 = 7 V oor die resistor.

questions.q: Which resistor does she need?
questions.qAf: Watter resistor het sy nodig?
questions.explain: R = V ÷ I = 7 ÷ 0.01 = 700 Ω. (350 Ω would be the answer for 20 mA.)
questions.explainAf: R = V ÷ I = 7 ÷ 0,01 = 700 Ω. (350 Ω sou die antwoord vir 20 mA wees.)

questions.q: Why does the LED need a resistor at all?
questions.qAf: Hoekom het die LED hoegenaamd 'n resistor nodig?
options: The LED has very low internal resistance, so on its own it draws too much current and burns out
optionsAf: Om die LED helderder te maak
Die LED het baie lae interne weerstand, dus trek dit op sy eie te veel stroom en brand dit uit
Om die LED se kleur te verander
questions.explain: An LED has very low internal resistance. Connected directly, it draws too much current and burns out. A current-limiting resistor in series protects it.
questions.explainAf: 'n LED het baie lae interne weerstand. As dit direk gekoppel word, trek dit te veel stroom en brand dit uit. 'n Stroombeperkende resistor in serie beskerm dit.

questions.q: In the Blinky program, setting the LED pin HIGH switches the LED off.
questions.qAf: In die Blinky-program skakel die LED af wanneer die pen op HIGH gestel word.
questions.explain: HIGH is 5 V, which switches the LED on. LOW (0 V) switches it off. Blinky: HIGH → wait 1 second → LOW → wait 1 second.
questions.explainAf: HIGH is 5 V, wat die LED aanskakel. LOW (0 V) skakel dit af. Blinky: HIGH → wag 1 sekonde → LOW → wag 1 sekonde.
